title: adenostyles albida subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Adenostyles albida subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean hoary cress, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is a perennial herb native to the Pyrenees region. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Adenostyles albida subsp. pyrenaica include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiproliferative effects, and flavonoids with antioxidant properties.
